items.title: Nota Groep listed by Inc Ransom
items.summary: Transportation-sector firm Nota Groep appeared on the Inc Ransom leak site, discovered November 10, 2026; operational impact unconfirmed.

items.title: n0n group claims US victim (Company #188)
items.summary: The n0n ransomware group claimed an unnamed United States organization with an attack date of November 9, 2026.

items.title: Zirnet LLC listed by Inc Ransom
items.summary: Technology-sector company Zirnet LLC was posted as an Inc Ransom victim; listing date and impact not yet independently confirmed.

items.title: Q3 2026 ransomware claims up 23%
items.summary: Leak-site victim claims reached 2,865 in Q3 2026, a 23% rise, setting the backdrop for Q4 activity.

ransomware.note: Named-victim news coverage for November is thin; current items come from leak-site trackers and are unverified claims.

items.title: Google Cloud europe-west2-b power loss (London)
items.summary: A third-party facility hosting the europe-west2-b zone lost utility power on October 20 and a controller fault stopped backup generators from starting.

items.title: H1 2026 cloud & SaaS reliability report
items.summary: IncidentHub tracked 30,246 outages across providers in the first half of 2026, including a Feb 2–3 Azure VM/AKS outage.

outage.note: No major AWS/Azure/GCP outage reported in the first half of November 2026; items shown are recent reference events.

items.title: CISA adds six exploited flaws to KEV (Nov 10)
items.summary: New KEV entries cover Microsoft Outlook, Google Chrome, Barracuda appliances, Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave Webtop.

items.title: CISA KEV: GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, OpenSSH, Aspera Faspex
items.summary: Four actively exploited flaws were added on November 9 with an unusually short November 12 federal remediation deadline.

items.title: Node2Shell flaw exploited in the wild
items.summary: CISA warned that attackers are now exploiting the critical Node2Shell vulnerability and urged immediate patching.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-111357 / 118527
items.summary: Ivanti expanded its advisory with two exploited Connect Secure flaws; CISA set a November 13 deadline for federal agencies.

items.title: Zyxel GS1900 zero-day hijacks 996 switches
items.summary: CVE-2026-107441 was used to take over 996 Zyxel GS1900 switches; a patch shipped October 22 and the advisory followed November 3.

items.title: Apple CVE-2024-27834 added to KEV, tied to APT29
items.summary: CISA listed an older Apple WebKit flaw on November 4 (due November 18), with one briefing linking it to APT29 targeting legacy iPhones.

items.title: M 6.4 – 30 km WSW of Lata, Solomon Islands
items.summary: USGS recorded a magnitude 6.4 earthquake on November 9 with a green PAGER alert and no tsunami warning.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu landfall, Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: Cyclone Murasu made landfall on India's Andhra Pradesh coast on November 3, the second cyclone there in under a week.

items.title: Brazil & Ecuador flooding
items.summary: Brazil recognized emergencies in 44 municipalities across 13 states, with 671 storm incidents in Santa Catarina; flooding in Ecuador killed 12.

items.title: Wind-driven wildfires in Spokane, Washington
items.summary: Three wildfires driven by powerful winds damaged or destroyed nearly 1,000 buildings in Spokane neighborhoods.

items.title: Northern Mexico heavy rain
items.summary: Weekend rainfall across four northern Mexican states left two dead, 450 homes affected and 45 people rescued.

physical.note: El Niño-driven Pacific cyclone season continues; Atlantic remains historically quiet.
